title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Information to be Disclosed and Submitted in the Business Report)
① The following information must be disclosed in the business report in accordance with Article 25(2) of the Act:
1. An overview of the accounting firm
   a. Financial statements and accompanying schedules
   b. Revenue by business sector for the past three fiscal years, including audits, tax accounting, and management consulting
   c. Other information regarding the accounting firm's management status, such as organizational structure and partnerships with foreign accounting firms, as determined by the Financial Supervisory Service
2. Information regarding the standards for the audit firm's work design and operation in accordance with Article 17(1) of the Act
3. Information regarding the accounting firm's personnel
   a. Status of directors, employees, and affiliated certified public accountants
   b. Personnel and compensation by business sector for the past three fiscal years, including audits, tax accounting, and management consulting
   c. Other information regarding personnel training and changes, as determined by the Financial Supervisory Service
4. Establishment of a reserve for compensation in accordance with Article 28(1) of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants," establishment of a compensation joint fund in accordance with Article 32(1) of the Act, and Article 38(1) of the Act

Information regarding enrollment in liability insurance:

5. The results of supervision and evaluation (hereinafter referred to as "supervision") under Article 26(1) of the "Act on the Establishment of the Financial Supervisory Committee, etc." by the Financial Supervisory Committee within the past 3 years, as specified by the Financial Supervisory Committee.
6. Information regarding civil and criminal lawsuits related to the business activities of the accounting firm (including the company's directors and affiliated certified public accountants) within the past 3 years.
② The format for preparing the business report as described in Article 1 shall be determined by the head of the Financial Supervisory Service.
③ The accounting firm may submit the business report as described in Article 1 to the head of the Financial Supervisory Service and the Korean Certified Public Accountants Association in the form of electronic documents as defined in Article 2(5) of the "Act on Promotion of Use of Information and Communications Networks and Protection of Information."
